incidents.title: NAV recomputation incident — April price feed format change
incidents.description: Vendor price-feed format change caused three NAV recomputations in April before the tolerance-check patch was deployed.

incidents.title: Attempted account takeover on investor portal
incidents.description: Automated credential-stuffing attempts detected against investor portal login; no successful takeover, portal auto-blocked source IPs.

incidents.title: Dealing desk fat-finger order — wrong scheme code
incidents.description: Dealer entered an order against the wrong scheme code; caught by dual authorization before execution, absorbed as a near-miss.

incidents.title: RTA interface brief outage during EOD batch
incidents.description: RTA interface connectivity dropped for 40 minutes during end-of-day batch processing, delaying folio updates by one cycle.

incidents.title: Penetration test finding: DMZ lateral movement path
incidents.description: External penetration test confirmed an exploitable path from the web DMZ into RTA interface servers via unpatched middleware.

rootCauseAnalyses.rootCauseSummary: Vendor changed the price file delimiter without notice; ingestion parser silently defaulted stale values instead of failing loud.
rootCauseAnalyses.contributingFactors: No schema-change notification clause in the vendor contract; parser lacked strict validation.

rootCauseAnalyses.rootCauseSummary: Unpatched middleware version combined with flat network segmentation allowed lateral movement from DMZ to interface servers.
rootCauseAnalyses.contributingFactors: Patch SLA breach (see control exception CEX-2026-0001); segmentation baseline not enforced on interface subnet.

issues.title: Price-feed ingestion lacks strict schema validation
issues.description: The root cause of INC-2026-0001 — ingestion accepts malformed price files instead of rejecting them — is a systemic gap beyond the single incident.

issues.title: Interface subnet segmentation not enforced per baseline
issues.description: The DMZ-to-interface lateral movement path exposed a systemic segmentation gap versus the network segmentation baseline (SBL-2026-0002).

capas.title: Harden price-feed ingestion validation
capas.description: Implement strict schema and delimiter validation on the price-feed ingestion pipeline with hard failure on malformed files.

capas.title: Enforce network segmentation baseline on interface subnet
capas.description: Apply and verify the network segmentation baseline on all RTA/interface subnets; add continuous compliance scanning.

capas.title: Vendor contract schema-change notification clause
capas.description: Add a mandatory 30-day advance notice clause for price-feed schema changes to the vendor contract renewal.

capaActionItems.description: Define strict JSON/CSV schema for accepted price-feed formats.
Deploy validation gate rejecting non-conforming files with alerting.
Apply segmentation rules to interface subnet firewall.
Add continuous compliance scan for segmentation drift.

incidentEscalations.title: Critical penetration test finding escalation
incidentEscalations.escalationReason: Critical severity DMZ lateral movement path requires CRO and CISO joint acknowledgement.

incidentEscalations.title: Segmentation CAPA nearing due date escalation
incidentEscalations.escalationReason: System-raised: CAPA target completion within 14 days with two open action items.
